Name: Mayank Ratan Bhardwaj
Bio:
Prof Mayank Ratan Bhardwaj is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University. He earned his PhD from the Department of Computer Science and Automation at the Indian Institute of Science and his MTech from IIT Kanpur. His doctoral dissertation focused on improving agricultural planning and operations using Artificial Intelligence and Game Theory.

He has experience working across different industry verticals, contributing to the development of firmware, video conferencing tools, EDA tools, search engines, and business development initiatives.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru | MTech, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Kanpur
Research_Interests: Applied Game Theory | Mechanism Design | Graph Theory | Data Analytics | Computational Social Choice | Game Theory | AI for Social Good
